title: alea-intake — Persona UAT Campaign (live validation)
description: Live end-to-end validation of the intake pipeline across three rounds. Round 1 (session 3): five deploy-test-diagnose-fix cycles took the pipeline from fully inert to live; judged vs v1.1 at 4/6, 3/6, 3/6 gates. Round 2 (session 4): BUG-12..16 + GATE-01 + q10 fixes; re-judged vs LOCKED v1.2 at 4/6, 2/6, 3/6 — four blockers routed (BUG-18 empty JSON exports, BUG-21 semantic-fit false confidence, BUG-19 rewriter leak, BUG-20 DV resource mismatch). Round 3 (session 5, this update): all four engineering bugs fixed + BUG-16 root cause found (multi-jurisdiction runs structurally skipped question_gen), 7 fix commits deployed, 3 personas re-run (runs 30/31/34, memos 63-77), re-judged vs LOCKED v1.2 by 3 independent judges + deterministic sidecars. Gates: LT 5/6 (up), IMM 2/6 (flat, mostly PENDING-DAMIEN), FC 3/6 (flat). BUG-18/19/20 verified fixed live; BUG-21's validator works in the issue_spot lane but the exploration/discovered lane bypasses it (RUB-05 still gates). Expansion not run (decision rule: all-gates-clear required). Round 4 (session 6): Damien's four rulings implemented + BUG-22..27 fixed (9 commits incl. sibling RUB-01/08 work); re-run + re-judged vs LOCKED v1.3 (strictest rulings) at 2/6, 2/6, 5/6 — v1.3's stricter gates surface new failure classes (fabrication in prose synthesis, lapsed-deadline exception routing, strict primary-source citations on every computed deadline, full doctrine depth).
spend: app-side ~$4-5 est. campaign total (gpt-4o-mini): rounds 1-2 ~$2-3; round 3 ~ $1.5-2 (5 full persona pipeline runs incl. immigration re-runs during BUG-16 diagnosis). Judging is orchestration-side. 8-persona expansion NOT run. Round 4: app-side ~$1-1.5 (3 persona pipeline runs, gpt-4o-mini); judging orchestration-side (3 judge subagents).
environment: Railway alea-intake-dev (gpt-4o-mini), commit 170c1ad (== master at final re-run; deploy verified via /health before each persona run)

sections.title: Campaign result — round-4 gates summary (FIRST judging vs LOCKED v1.3)
sections.body: Gates vs LOCKED v1.3 (round-3/v1.2 -> round-4/v1.3, NOT directly comparable — v1.3 is strictly harder): landlord-tenant 5/6 -> 2/6 (01 FAIL new doctrine-depth gate: rent-escrow §504B.385 / defective-notice / post-lapse what-now all absent; 04 FAIL NEW: memo asserts 'the doctor's documentation of asthma' while narrative says 'i dont have like a doctor saying that in writing yet' — fabricated corroboration; 08 FAIL: Apr-1 hearing + Mar-17 notice correctly computed AND flagged lapsed, but v1.3 requires routing to the what-now pathway (motion to vacate / expungement §484.014) — absent; 09 FAIL: 14-day pay-or-quit computed via generic_notice_window citing 'period stated in your notice or lease' — codified-law deadline (§504B.321) without a pin-cite GATE-fails under strict r3; 05+15 PASS). immigration 2/6 -> 2/6 (01 FAIL: U-status/I-918B, §245(c)(2)+VAWA exemption, Pereira probe, §208(a)(2)(D) routing all absent — the new prompts landed on master but the LLM did not surface them this run; 04 FAIL NEW: invented 'notice posted on 2026-07-11' trigger drives a phantom Jul-16 address-change deadline; 08 FAIL: asylum one-year bar (entry Aug 14 2019 -> lapsed Aug 14 2020) never extracted as a deadline event — detection gap, not engine gap (engine computes+flags lapsed when fed the event, test-verified); 09 FAIL: address-change deadline cites the lease cure/vacate rule instead of 8 C.F.R. §1003.15(d)/EOIR-33 — wrong-authority cite; 05+15 PASS). family-custody 3/6 -> 5/6 (04/05/08/09/15 PASS — §518.12 answer deadline computed Jul-15 with the CORRECTED citation, exec summaries substantive, exports clean; 01 FAIL: §518.17 subd. 1(a)(4) domestic-abuse best-interest factor + parental-abduction/flight-risk interim terms absent — the abduction threats live only in the text-thread upload, which still contributes zero facts). DECISION GATE: not all 3 pass all 6 -> 5-persona expansion PARKED.

Prac. 303.03 was WRONG — motion timing, not answer deadline) + detection prompt routes served petitions to trigger=served with the service date; FC 'served Jun 15' now computed=true Jul 15 with correct cite (round-3: computed=false). sections.title: Bugs OPEN after round 4 (v1.3 failure classes)
sections.body: BUG-28 [RUB-04, LT+IMM] NEW CLASS — fabrication in prose synthesis: LT memo asserts doctor documentation the client explicitly lacks; IMM invents a 'notice posted 2026-07-11' trigger event producing a phantom computed deadline. The no-fabrication gate now fails on LLM-synthesized prose, not extracted facts. BUG-29 [RUB-08, LT+IMM] — lapsed-deadline what-now routing: engine flags lapsed correctly but memos never route to the exception pathway (LT: motion to vacate/expungement §484.014; IMM: §208(a)(2)(D)); sibling's exception-routing code did not manifest in this run's memos. BUG-30 [RUB-09, LT+IMM] — generic-rule citations GATE-fail under strict r3: stated_court_date + generic_notice_window rules cite 'your notice/lease/court notice' instead of the governing codified authority; rules table needs jurisdiction-aware pin-cites (LT 14-day notice = §504B.321 subd. 1a; IMM address change = 8 C.F.R. §1003.15(d)). BUG-31 [RUB-08, IMM] — asylum one-year bar never extracted as a deadline event from 'I came to this country August 14, 2019' (deadline_detect misses entry-date events with no explicit deadline language); the engine's lapsed+exception path is test-verified but unreachable without the event. BUG-27 [RUB-01/16, FC] STILL OPEN in effect — text-thread upload contributes zero facts (abduction threats never reach the fact base); normalized_text fix landed but this upload path still leaks. RUB-01 depth [all 3]: doctrine probes landed on master but surfaced questions remain generic; needs verification of which stage output the probes reached. Non-gate: FK grade 12.7-14.5 vs ~6 target (RUB-10); 21-25 [URGENT] tags dilute real urgency (RUB-11); 'Untitled Intake' matter titles.

sections.title: Campaign result — round-3 gates summary
sections.body: Gates vs LOCKED v1.2 (round 2 -> round 3): landlord-tenant 4/6 -> 5/6 (RUB-08/09/15 now pass; only RUB-05 fails); immigration 2/6 -> 2/6 (RUB-04/09 pass; RUB-01+08 remain PENDING-DAMIEN doctrine/lapsed-deadline items; RUB-05+15 engineering); family-custody 3/6 -> 3/6 (RUB-01/04/09 pass; RUB-05/08/15 fail). All four round-2 engineering blockers verified FIXED live: BUG-18 (JSON exports carry full claims/deadlines/questions + sidecar now asserts substance), BUG-19 (zero rewriter-error leaks in all 9 memos vs 26+ in round 2), BUG-20 (all FC memos lead with National DV Hotline 1-800-799-7233; immigration orgs gone; word-boundary matcher kills the 'ice'-in-'office' false positive), BUG-16 root cause (orchestrator's multi-jurisdiction branch broke out of the stage loop, structurally skipping question_gen — immigration now gets 9 questions, latest_stage=question_gen). RUB-05 still gates all three because the semantic-fit validator only guards the issue_spot lane; exploration/'discovered' claims carry their own IRIs that bypass it (new BUG-22). A newly visible shared defect: executive_summary is an empty string in every export (BUG-23) — judges split on whether it gate-fails RUB-15 (LT judge: pass w/ defect; IMM/FC judges: fail). DECISION RULE HONORED: gates not clear on all three -> 5-persona expansion NOT run. Immigration is hard-blocked on PENDING-DAMIEN items regardless of further engineering.

sections.title: Bugs FIXED this round (verified live, commits on master)
sections.body_html:
• BUG-18 [RUB-15] — JSON exports were empty shells: generation persisted only markdown; export rebuilt an EMPTY OutputContext. Fix: serialize the final post-adaptation context into rendered_json at generation (c8f49cd). Sidecars persona_run.py/memo_checks.py now assert json_substance so an empty shell hard-fails RUB-15 (996c896). Verified: all 9 round-3 JSON exports carry claims_by_jurisdiction / deadlines / questions.
  • BUG-19 — rewriter refusals ('It seems there was an issue with the text provided...', 'I'm sorry, but I cannot assist') returned as SUCCESSFUL completions and leaked into memos/PDFs as claim conclusions. Fix: refusal-signature detection fails closed to the unrewritten prose, logged server-side (4bb1888). Verified: 0 leaks across all round-3 memos.
  • BUG-20 — DV persona lacked the DV hotline. Three root causes fixed (a176265): substring keyword matching ('ice' fired inside police/Office/Justice/notice/service -> word-boundary matching); DV protocol only matched formal phrases (added lay-DV keywords/regex: 'left a bruise', 'don't you dare call the cops'); assembler guardrail guarantees the National DV Hotline whenever the DV/abuse/stalking domain is active. Verified: memos 63/64/65 lead with 1-800-799-7233, immigration orgs gone.
  • BUG-21 [RUB-05] (partial — issue_spot lane) — semantic-fit validation stage added to claim mapping (27917a4): tier-1 deterministic geographic/placeholder/branch rejection + tier-2 single batched gpt-4o-mini context-fitness call with confidence recalibration; wrong mappings drop the IRI. Verified working: round-2 pairs fixed (Habitability maps to a real habitability concept @0.85; Retaliation/Rent-Escrow correctly rejected to iri=None @0.4; Rize/Markman gone). NOT yet covering the exploration lane — see BUG-22.
  • BUG-16 (root cause) — immigration questions=0 was NOT an LLM refusal: the orchestrator's multi-jurisdiction branch did break after the parallel fact_map/gap_analyze pass, structurally skipping question_gen on any run with >1 jurisdiction (170c1ad). Defense-in-depth also shipped: gap batch capped to top-20 by priority (ab99acd), legal-aid prompt framing + deterministic fallback questions on LLM failure or valid-but-empty result (50f97f9, dc419e9). Verified: immigration run 34 has 9 questions, latest_stage=question_gen.

Fix: run every surfaced claim mapping (exploration + issue_spot + any lane) through SemanticFitValidator before persistence.
  • BUG-23 [RUB-15, all 3] (engineering) — executive_summary is an empty string in every export and memo while profile.sections.executive_summary=true and completeness reads 1.0; the assembler never generates one. Judges split on gate impact (LT pass-with-defect, IMM/FC fail).
  • BUG-24 (engineering) — FC response deadline (served Jun 15 + 30 days = Jul 15, 7 days out!) echoed but computed=false/rule_id=null: the deadline rules table lacks the MN custody-response 30-day rule. Highest-stakes single miss this round.
  • BUG-25 (engineering) — triage practice-area routing leaks the claim_type enum ('discovered'/'identified') as the practice-area label in all consumer memos; routing table meaningless.
  • BUG-26 (engineering) — fact-linkage duplication: the same fact span repeats up to 11-20x per element in memos and exports (all personas).
  • BUG-27 (engineering, FC) — uploads extracted ('completed') but contributing zero facts: 'Threatening Texts' element marked Unsupported although the uploaded text-thread IS the threatening texts; summons-only details (courtroom, file no.) absent from all outputs.
  • PENDING-DAMIEN (routed, not engineering) — RUB-01 doctrine depth (IMM: asylum 1-yr lapse + exceptions, U visa, §245(c)/VAWA linkage; FC: §518B.01/§518.17 naming; LT: §504B statutory framing); RUB-08 lapsed-deadline computation (asylum 1-yr = Aug 14 2020); primary-source citation depth (RUB-09 scores 1 everywhere, gate-passes only because nothing wrong is asserted).
